Name: (CP) Gothic Catgirl Abigail
Author: hyperdexia
Description:
Gothic Catgirl Abigail v1.1

I take [i]no[/i] credit for the amazing work put forth by these previous modders & artists. All I did was move around my favorite parts of their corresponding Abigail images, combining them all into the perfect Abigail, enjoy!

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2586 (goth abi, by [i]wetfart[/i])
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3779 (catgirl abi, by winters & sakurasflower)
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450 (winter Abi outfits, by [i]Poltergeister[/i] & various artists)

Manifest.Name: (CP) Gothic Catgirl Abigail
Manifest.Description: Gives Abigail a gothic & feline aesthetic. Includes portraits and sprites. Portrait is straight from Sakura's 'CAT GIRL mod,' modified further with other Abigail mods.
